§3§lDaily and milestone rewards§r
Claim daily rewards from the calendar in the sign-in tab. Defaults are §110§r Neko Coins on weekdays, §120§r on weekends and a streak coefficient of §11.0§r; servers can adjust these values.

Each streak milestone can be claimed once per month. Cumulative milestones are one-time account rewards: the default §130 / 100 / 365§r days award §1100 / 300 / 1000§r coins respectively.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the sign-in and milestone rules, then tick the checkbox. This quest does not check an actual sign-in record.
